GET /api/products.description: Products in stock in one UK size, or for bras one band (optionally one cup), optionally in one category (clothes, swimwear, activewear, lingerie). With no size, Products in stock in at least one plus size (UK 18+ or band 38+), with size_label and fits null. Every result has in_stock_sizes: its in-stock plus Size labels, UK sizes ascending, then bands and cups

GET /api/products/:product_id.description: One Product with all its Size labels

POST /api/click-outs.description: Live check, then { outcome: 'sent', url } or { outcome: 'sold_out', message, similar }

DELETE /api/retailers/:retailer_id.description: Remove a Retailer; its Products leave search at once

GET /api/review.description: The Review list: unsettled Size labels, Products and Suggested Retailers
